title: Verification Policy
content:
Verification Policy

This page explains what Aerogela means by Verified and how that label differs from standard editorial review.

Meaning of the Verified label

Verified is a directory trust label used to indicate that a listing has received a higher-confidence confirmation signal than a normal editorially reviewed profile.

Possible verification signals

  • An approved Claim Listing workflow tied to the listed organization
  • Direct confirmation from a business representative
  • Matching public business details and internal review records sufficient for stronger confidence

What Verified does not mean

  • It is not a guarantee of product performance, creditworthiness, legal compliance, or business reputation.
  • It is not a substitute for your own technical, procurement, legal, or supplier due diligence.
  • It does not mean Aerogela has audited a factory, laboratory, financial statements, or certifications unless explicitly stated elsewhere.

How a listing may lose verification

  • Claim ownership changes or cannot be maintained
  • Public information materially conflicts with prior verification signals
  • The website or core business identity becomes unclear, inactive, or misleading

How to request verification or correction

If you represent an organization and want to request review, verification, or a correction, start with:

  • Claim Listing
  • Submit a Listing
